# Eight top-impression guides and posts get search descriptions

## Context

Julia's three-month Search Console export (`sc-domain:neomjs.com`, read for #20671) shows these routes earning impressions with zero clicks. Their snippet is a narrative or contrastive opening line, because none of the eight files carries front-matter:

| Route | Impressions | Avg. position | Description served today begins |
| --- | ---: | ---: | --- |
| `/learn/guides/testing/UnitTesting` | 38 | 14 | "Neo.mjs uses a unique "Single-Thread Simulation"…" |
| `/news/blog/the-organism-already-existed` | 11 | 6.64 | "In April 2026, in only the second Claude Code session…" |
| `/learn/guides/testing/WhiteboxE2E` | 4 | 7.75 | "Traditional end-to-end (E2E) testing treats…" |
| `/news/blog/one-repository-per-reader` | 4 | 7.75 | "Before 13.2, cloning Neo.mjs meant…" |
| `/news/blog/the-salute` | 2 | 3.5 | "A team of AI agents "checks its own work"…" |
| `/learn/agentos/FleetManagerArchitecture` | 1 | 7 | "Open a terminal on a machine…" |
| `/learn/benefits/Introduction` | (reindex requested 11-21) | | "On a normal night here, with no human awake…" |
| `/learn/guides/datahandling/StateProviders` | (reindex queued) | | "While individual Components can manage…" |

## The Problem

At about 200 impressions a day, click-through on each impression multiplies directly into visitors. A snippet that opens on a scene, or on what the page is not, does not tell the searcher what the page answers.

## The Architectural Reality

- `seoJson.mjs` reads `seoTitle` and `seoDescription` front-matter (#20917). Without it, the description falls back to the first paragraph. `prepare` regenerates `seo.json` into the release commit (#21809), and middleware-v2 serves it to crawlers.
- Design authority: "Every canonical route in sitemap-core.xml … resolves a" route-specific title and description (#20917).

## The Fix

Add one `seoDescription` line of front-matter to each of the eight files: one sentence, under about 160 characters, built only from the page's own text. Titles and body copy stay as they are, so #20917's identity cluster is untouched.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Each of the eight files carries a `seoDescription` stating what the page answers, every claim traceable to the page itself.
- [ ] A regenerated `seo.json` carries the eight descriptions, and `node buildScripts/docs/seo/verify.mjs` passes.

## Out of Scope

Titles and H1s (#20917), body copy, the boilerplate-lead fallback ("Pre-requisite:", "Release Type:"), and the Brain-hosted `/learn/agentos/*` guides that #20920's A0 restores.
